system.summary: Four unrelated short ciphers: (a) figure substitution with a small code, (b) figures mixed with letters, (c) a ten-digit cipher, (d) homophonic figures with two codes.
system.sibling_key: Every 1653-60 royalist and Commonwealth key on cryptiana (Marshall, Barwick-Hyde, Stamford, Butler, Charles II intercepted, Kingston, Westrope, Hague agent/Blake) tried; none fits.
system.notes: Four separate systems, so types is undetermined for the set; NOTES read (a) as monoalphabetic letters plus a small code (8 code groups) and (d) as homophonic letters plus codes 226 243. nomenclator.entries counts the 10 code groups seen in (a) and (d).

prior_solution.where: Listed as undeciphered by Tomokiyo (cryptiana item #9); Birch's transcriptions are the only online witness and carry no decipherment.

tools: apply_keys.py (period keys scored by quadgram LM)
solve_a2.py (simulated annealing, bijective and homophonic modes)

solution.what: Extracted the four ciphertexts from Birch's Thurloe State Papers on British History Online.
Frequencies and repeats of each piece (analyze.py).
Applied every 1653-60 key from cryptiana to (a)-(d), scored by English/Dutch/French quadgrams; best -4.8 to -5.4 per quad against about -3.2 for real text.
Hill-climb on (a) with Dutch and French quadgram LMs, bijective and homophonic, 8 restarts: best -4.71 per quad, Dutch-looking fragments only.
(a) as a plain alphabetical key on 10-33 with any rotation or reversal.
(c) 'the king' for the 4-sign word forces an impossible name pattern; unresolvable at 16 symbols.
(d) cribs like 'horse' and 'hang' in the rich clear frame fit many assignments equally well.

outcome.notes: Verdict STUCK: too short for cryptanalysis, no key online. Originals in Bodleian Rawlinson A, not digitised; sibling decipherments would be in the Nationaal Archief (a) and the Clarendon MSS (b-d), not online. No matched control is recorded for the solver failure on (a). The only commit (347fef4b5, 2026-09-15) has no model trailer.
